description: This file contains the implementation of rbusProperty-related functions for managing properties in the RBUS framework, including creation, destruction, accessors, mutators, and serialization functions.

classes.name: _rbusProperty
classes.description: Structure representing a property with retain count, name, value, and next pointer.

methods.name: rbusProperty_t rbusProperty_Init(rbusProperty_t * pproperty,char const * name,rbusValue_t value)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new rbusProperty instance with a specified name and value.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_Destroy(rtRetainable * r)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a rbusProperty instance.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_Retain(rbusProperty_t property)
methods.description: Increments the retain count of a property.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_Release(rbusProperty_t property)
methods.description: Decrements the retain count and destroys the property when it reaches zero.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_Releases(int count,...)
methods.description: Releases multiple properties at once.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_fwrite(rbusProperty_t prop,int depth,FILE * fout)
methods.description: Serializes the property and its linked list to a file in a human-readable format.

methods.name: int rbusProperty_Compare(rbusProperty_t property1,rbusProperty_t property2)
methods.description: Compares two properties based on their names and values.

methods.name: char const * rbusProperty_GetName(rbusProperty_t property)
methods.description: Returns the name of the property.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_SetName(rbusProperty_t property,char const * name)
methods.description: Sets the name of the property.

methods.name: rbusValue_t rbusProperty_GetValue(rbusProperty_t property)
methods.description: Returns the value associated with the property.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_SetValue(rbusProperty_t property,rbusValue_t value)
methods.description: Sets the value of the property.

methods.name: rbusProperty_t rbusProperty_GetNext(rbusProperty_t property)
methods.description: Returns the next property in the linked list.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_SetNext(rbusProperty_t property,rbusProperty_t next)
methods.description: Sets the next property in the linked list.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_Append(rbusProperty_t property,rbusProperty_t back)
methods.description: Appends a property at the end of the linked list.

methods.name: uint32_t rbusProperty_Count(rbusProperty_t property)
methods.description: Counts the number of linked properties.

methods.name: rbusProperty_t rbusProperty_InitString(char const * name,char const * s)
methods.description: Initializes a property with a string value.

methods.name: rbusProperty_t rbusProperty_InitBytes(char const * name,uint8_t const * bytes,int len)
methods.description: Initializes a property with a byte array.

methods.name: char const * rbusProperty_GetString(rbusProperty_t property,int * len)
methods.description: Retrieves string value from the property's value.

methods.name: uint8_t const * rbusProperty_GetBytes(rbusProperty_t property,int * len)
methods.description: Retrieves byte array from the property's value.

methods.name: rbusValueError_t rbusProperty_GetStringEx(rbusProperty_t property,char const ** s,int * len)
methods.description: Gets extended string info from the value.

methods.name: rbusValueError_t rbusProperty_GetBytesEx(rbusProperty_t property,uint8_t const ** bytes,int * len)
methods.description: Gets extended byte info from the value.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_SetString(rbusProperty_t property,char const * s)
methods.description: Sets the property's value as a string.

methods.name: void rbusProperty_SetBytes(rbusProperty_t property,uint8_t const * bytes,int len)
methods.description: Sets the property's value as a byte array.

methods.name: rbusProperty_t rbusProperty_AppendString(rbusProperty_t property,char const * name,char const * s)
methods.description: Appends a string property.

methods.name: rbusProperty_t rbusProperty_AppendBytes(rbusProperty_t property,char const * name,uint8_t const * bytes,int len)
methods.description: Appends a byte array property.
